reason: I won't put a startup with no customers and no SOC 2 report inline in our order path, even for free. My engineers already rate-limit every key, and no examiner has asked us an agent-control question we can't answer yet.
objection: It's a proxy in front of every agent trade, so if it goes down or gets breached it becomes my outage and my finding. 'SOC 2 planned, not done' means my vendor-risk review stops on page one.
would_change_my_mind: A clean SOC 2 Type II report, plus an examiner or auditor asking us how we identify and limit customers' AI agents and us having no good answer.
